text:
Nora: Heads-up: were seeing duplicate training invites for the new interviewer workshop this morning. 3 panelists got 2 invites each. noticed around 09:05 UTC.
Priya: Ugh, thanks. Which jobs/workshops?
Nora: "Interviewers: New Hire + IC Calibration" event, template id `int-train-v3`.
Jin: Could be related to the UID normalization in the ATS -> calendar integration that went out last night (PR 3489).
Sam: are duplicates causing double slots on calendars or just duplicate emails?
Nora: duplicate emails and duplicate calendar entries for some folks (they see 2 invites). no time conflicts, just duplicates.
recruiter-bot: [automated] queued 6 duplicate invite workflows for template `int-train-v3` from 2169009000-2169009600.
Olivia: i saw one of these. i declined both and one stayed in calendar as "maybe". annoyed interviewers already replied.
Priya: priority: stop more duplicates, then dedupe existing invites. can we pause the calendar producer?
Jin: pausing producer for training_invites namespace at 09:18 UTC. will also run a query to find duplicates: `SELECT invite_id, count(*) FROM calendar_invites WHERE template='int-train-v3' AND created_ts > 2169000000 GROUP BY invite_id HAVING count(*)>1;`
Sam: great. jin, pls check if the UID normalization changed `invite_user_id` mapping so the system treats the same user as two identities (email vs external_id).
Jin: preliminary: the webhook now sets `invite_user_id = coalesce(external_id, email)` which collapsed before but last-night refactor reversed it for batches, creating both forms in queue. patching to enforce a single canonical id.
Priya: can we also send a short apology note to affected interviewers and offer to remove duplicate calendar items? i'll draft one.
Nora: patch deployed at 09:42 UTC. paused queue resumed after dedupe check. recruiter-bot will backfill remaining invites but with dedupe middleware enabled.
recruiter-bot: [automated] dedupe middleware enabled for `int-train-v3`. backfill scheduled at 10:30 UTC.
Sam: checklist before we close: 1) confirm DB dedupe script run (jin) 2) comms sent to affected interviewers (priya) 3) monitor for recurrence for 24h (nora) 4) link to PR 3489 and hotfix (jin).
Jin: DB dedupe script ran, removed 7 duplicate rows. linked PR and hotfix in RECR-4890.
Priya: comms sent to 9 interviewers and hiring leads, offered manual clean-up.
Nora: monitoring alert added if >2 duplicates per template in 15m.
Sam: thanks team. closing the thread, will convert RECR-4890 to postmortem doc after we collect logs. :+1:
